infer current telemetry from stale samples

upgrade_recipe: preserve every existing workflow destination

run Swift tests and capture supported window widths

inputs: existing canonical Mercury dashboard CLI read

never start a competing collector

reject removed routes and machine capacity drift
cancel pending navigation after the operator leaves

never treat UI state as backend operation authority
